newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bourse to be closed Dec 28-Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bourse to be closed Dec 28-Jan 2.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday it would be closed for the year-end holidays from December 28 to January 2.
The exchange said in a statement trading would end for the year at 3.40 p.m. (0640 GMT), including after-hours trading, on December 27.
Trading would start up again on Friday, January 3, with a limited two-hour session from 11.00 a.m.-1.00 p.m. (0200-0400 GMT).
